summary: The cut strip is clean, but at 79.26 the sky and clouds at the top of the hall change to a flat brown band and stay that way.

faults.what: The ceiling or sky band above the chandelier changes between neighbouring frames. It shows blue sky with pink clouds at 79.19 and 79.23, then a flat dark maroon-brown from 79.26 to 79.33. This is a texture or skybox drop-out, and it matches the measured spike.
faults.fix: Fix the sky or ceiling material so it stays loaded and visible through the end of the shot. Otherwise put a matching pink-sky texture on that band.
